name: CMX Holdings Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1983, Siel Financial Services Ltd was in the business leasing, advancing loan/ICD making investment, bill discounting and other financial activities.
keyPoints:
Operational Status:[1][2]
Objects of company, as mentioned in in its Memorandum of Association, are of a Non-Banking Financial Company. But company's operations are dormant for the past many years. There are no other employees except KMPs such as Whole Time Director, Chief Financial Officer and Company Secretary who are on the company rolls. Company applied for registration as a NBFC but Certificate for the same was never issued by Reserve Bank of India. At present, operations of company are restricted to realization of debtors and advances and interest income  on investments.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -24.2% over past five years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -12.6%
